headline: Tight Market Liquidity: Central Bank Unusually Cuts Issuance of 364-Day Deposit Certificates for a Second Consecutive Quarter | Industry & Finance
summary: Taiwan's central bank is reducing its monthly 364-day deposit certificate auction from NT$120 billion to NT$110 billion from October, a second quarterly cut as market liquidity tightens.
why: Central bank deposit certificates are used to manage excess liquidity in the banking system, so changes in issuance affect short-term funding rates and money-market conditions.
